INSERT INTO identity_providers
               (id, org_id, key, kind, config, enabled, created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::text::jsonb, $6,
                   timestamptz 'epoch' + $7::bigint * interval '1 microsecond',
                   timestamptz 'epoch' + $7::bigint * interval '1 microsecond')
           ON CONFLICT (org_id, key) DO UPDATE SET
               kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
               config = EXCLUDED.config,
               enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled,
               updated_at = CASE
                   WHEN (identity_providers.kind, identity_providers.config,
                         identity_providers.enabled)
                        IS DISTINCT FROM (EXCLUDED.kind, EXCLUDED.config, EXCLUDED.enabled)
                   THEN EXCLUDED.updated_at
                   ELSE identity_providers.updated_at
               END
           RETURNING id
